function: Excluded (above_phy): DDQN learns the AUE-to-TBS/LEO satellite association and DDPG learns the AUE trajectory for task-offloading energy; no learned physical-layer decision (p. 8).
notes: Exclude as above_phy. p. 8: "we employ DDQN and DDPG methods to address the association and trajectory optimization problems, respectively"; user association and UAV trajectory are above the physical layer. p. 8: "To solve the rest of the subproblems, we use the conventional convex optimization approach"; task allocation and TBS and LEO bandwidth and computing allocation are solved with CVXPY (pp. 10-11), not learned. Transmit power is not a decision variable of problem (34) (p. 7). The objective is the energy of task offloading in an integrated terrestrial-nonterrestrial MEC network (p. 1), not a physical-layer function of the seven areas.
